notes: Only tested model that completed both Qwen Code native tool gates: run_shell_command and write_file. The workflow-like 40-turn edit budget passed; an 8-turn quick pass was not reliable enough for the edit step.
Qwen Code exposes tools to the model, but the model printed fake JSON for run_shell_command instead of emitting an executable tool call.

Direct Ollama OpenAI-compatible forced tool call works, but through Qwen Code the model emitted text shaped like a tool call, including a dangling tool_call tag, rather than a valid executable Qwen Code tool call.
Ollama rejected Qwen Code tool use with HTTP 400: phi3.5:latest does not support tools.
